originalText:
FABLE 5 JUST MADE VIDEO CREATION FEEL LESS LIKE EDITING AND MORE LIKE REVIEWING OUTPUT

You give it the niche, the keyword, the format, the raw takes, and the goal. It writes the script, reads the transcripts, finds the strongest moments, creates the cut list, syncs the narration, adds captions

Builds title concepts, and leaves you with the part humans are still best at: deciding whether the result actually feels good

For faceless channels, the stack gets even cleaner: ElevenLabs speaks, Higgsfield creates visuals, Whisper timestamps, ffmpeg cuts

This is how a solo creator starts operating like a small media team
